response.justification: Bogdan Szabo is a strong full-stack and web-focused software engineer with broad experience across languages and platforms, but his background shows no evidence of SoC/IP modeling, hardware-software co-design, AI accelerator work, GPU/SIMD/MIMD architecture, or deep-learning performance optimization, which are the core requirements of this Principal Performance Architect role. His experience is almost entirely in web, mobile, and application-layer development rather than low-level hardware/chip architecture, making him a poor fit despite meeting general seniority and education criteria.
strengths: Extensive senior/staff-level software engineering experience across many domains
Strong open-source contributions and technical leadership (talks, workshops, founder role)
Meets baseline education and years-of-experience requirements
concerns: No demonstrated experience with SoC/IP modeling or chip architecture
No background in AI/deep-learning workload optimization or GPU/SIMD/MIMD architectures
Career trajectory is web/full-stack focused, not hardware performance engineering

key_factors.factor: No AI accelerator / deep-learning optimization background
